title: The Mother of the Sons of Zebedee Asks for Honor
description: The mother of James and John asks Jesus to grant her sons places of honor at his right and left hand in the kingdom. Jesus answers that they do not know what they are asking, and teaches the disciples that whoever wants to be great must become a servant to others—just as he came to serve and give his life as a ransom for many.
